nodes.question: Does the specific DVD shown in the small rectangular case near the center of the source image change from black to white in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Compare the source object near the center—a small rectangular DVD case with a visible disc/image—to the corresponding object in the edited image, using location, shape, and context. Do not treat separate newly visible white disc-like objects as the target. Complete if the corresponding DVD itself is white; partial if it has visibly changed from black toward white but is not white; absent if it remains black with no requested color change; unknown if the target or its correspondence cannot be established reliably.
nodes.binding: Target: the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image, identifiable by its rectangular outline and visible disc/image. Reference: that same DVD object in the edited image, matched by location, shape, and context; do not bind to separate white disc-like objects. If correspondence is uncertain, report unknown.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
